# MDFN

> Markdown-native authoring with source preservation, safe rendering, and collaboration.

## Documentation

- [Collaboration](https://mdfn.com/docs/collaboration) — Exchange authorized Yjs updates and compact exact batches.
- [Extensions and profiles](https://mdfn.com/docs/extensions) — Resolve syntax ownership, conflicts, and migrations.
- [Framework editors](https://mdfn.com/docs/framework-editors) — Install and mount a controller in React, Svelte, Solid, or the vanilla DOM.
- [Getting started](https://mdfn.com/docs/getting-started) — Install MDFN, edit Markdown, observe changes, and release the controller.
- [MDFN](https://mdfn.com/docs) — Markdown-native authoring with a durable source contract.
- [Integrations](https://mdfn.com/docs/integrations) — Connect assets, search, content, and AI through explicit bridges.
- [@mdfn/adapter-kit](https://mdfn.com/docs/reference/adapter-kit) — Source guide for adapter-kit.

- [@mdfn/testing](https://mdfn.com/docs/reference/testing) — Source guide for testing.
- [Rendering and security](https://mdfn.com/docs/rendering-and-security) — Apply a rendering policy to untrusted Markdown.
- [Review and sidecar](https://mdfn.com/docs/review-and-sidecar) — Keep editorial data bound to canonical source.
- [Server and storage](https://mdfn.com/docs/server-and-storage) — Mount authenticated document routes and save with optimistic concurrency.
- [Source preservation](https://mdfn.com/docs/source-preservation) — Keep untouched Markdown bytes and unknown constructs.
- [Verification](https://mdfn.com/docs/verification) — Run the consumer and browser gates for an MDFN integration.
